doctrine: Authority, cognition, and effect planes are type-distinct: values never convert without explicit boundary types, and cognition output can never grant effect authority.

authority.definition: Immutable observations, identities, policies, receipts, capability tokens, and canonical state
authority.mutation_rule: Authority may only be updated via verified cryptographic receipts or canonical ledger transitions

cognition.definition: Tracks, embeddings, hypotheses, rankings, model outputs, beliefs, and memories
cognition.mutation_rule: Cognition may propose but cannot directly mutate authority or perform effects

effect.definition: Alerts, PTZ, retention, export, deletion, activation, and repair mutations
effect.mutation_rule: Effects require prepared intent, capability, precondition, idempotency identity, and receipt

ambiguous.definition: Types that bridge multiple planes or combine source evidence with derived hypotheses; reported as findings without guessing

support.definition: Typed error structures, parser helpers, and foundational codec utilities

EffectAuthority.description: Explicit capability lease granting effect execution authority; never constructible from cognition output

EffectIntent.description: Prepared intent for mutation or external effect with idempotency identity

PreparedEffect.description: Staged, capability-bound mutation waiting for reconciliation or dispatch

EffectState.description: Lifecycle state of an effect: Prepared, Committed, AdapterAccepted, Observed, Verified, Indeterminate, Failed

Obligation.description: Terminal obligation tracking an effect to completion or safe failure

EffectJournal.description: Append-only canonical journal of effect transitions

EffectJournalTransition.description: Transition record for effect journal operations

OperationReceipt.description: Authoritative receipt proving an operation completed

ProviderObservationReceipt.description: External provider execution receipt confirming observation of effect

ProviderFailureReceipt.description: External provider failure receipt confirming failure of effect

EffectReconciliationRecord.description: Authoritative reconciliation record matching intent to terminal proof

IndeterminateEffectReason.description: Typed reason an operation entered indeterminate, kept on its receipt through reconciliation; unrecorded only for legacy v1 records (fss-deir9)

EffectRecordVersion.description: Version of a durable effect journal record and of the receipt encoding its operation uses; v1 keeps pre-deir9 witness bytes (fss-deir9)

ReceiptLookupStatus.description: Query lookup outcome for receipt verification

EffectSchemaError.description: Typed error enum for effect schema codec operations

BeliefInterval.description: Derived belief interval with upper and lower probability bounds; cognition only

Contradiction.description: Epistemic contradiction between competing hypotheses or belief intervals

BeliefError.description: Typed error enum for belief operations

ContextAuthority.description: Runtime execution authority context and capability scope

RootAuthoritySpec.description: Root capability specification for a regional execution context

ContextNarrowingSpec.description: Narrowed capability specification for regional isolation

QuiescenceProof.description: Witness and proof of complete regional quiescence without orphan work

TaskOutcome.description: Outcome status of an asynchronous task

RegionState.description: Lifecycle state of an execution region

RegionError.description: Typed error enum for regional operations

EventHypothesis.description: Derived event hypothesis revision produced by perceptual models or tracking
EventHypothesis.ambiguity_reason: Cognitive inference struct embedding authoritative source evidence anchors and classification kinds

EventRevision.ambiguity_reason: Type alias for EventHypothesis which bridges cognitive inference with authoritative evidence

ProbabilityInterval.description: Model uncertainty and probability interval estimate

DecisionPath.description: Cognitive decision routing and explanation path

CorroborationAnalysis.description: Cross-sensor corroboration analysis and evidence overlap

SensorTamperStatus.description: Accumulated active and retired sensor-tamper risk status across event revisions

TamperRecord.description: Internal record of an open sensor-tamper report with provenance metadata

EventTransitionParams.description: Parameters for authoritative event lifecycle transition

EventTransitionRule.description: Authoritative policy rule governing event state progression

EventKind.description: Authoritative semantic classification of event type

EventEvidence.description: Immutable reference to source observation evidence

EventLineage.description: Canonical, append-only history of event revisions and alert records
EventLineage.ambiguity_reason: Multi-plane container aggregating cognitive revisions (EventHypothesis) and effect records (AlertEffectRecord)

EvidenceEdgeRelation.description: Inferred cognitive relationship between evidence nodes

EvidenceGraph.description: Structured graph combining authoritative source evidence anchors with cognitive hypotheses
EvidenceGraph.ambiguity_reason: Bridges authority plane (immutable observation anchors) with cognition plane (inferred edge relations and hypotheses)

EvidenceNode.description: Node in evidence graph representing either an authoritative observation or cognitive hypothesis
EvidenceNode.ambiguity_reason: Multi-plane enum containing both raw sensor observations (authority) and inferred hypotheses (cognition)

EvidenceNodeKind.description: Classification enum for evidence node variants spanning multiple planes
EvidenceNodeKind.ambiguity_reason: Variants include both authority-plane observations and cognition-plane models/hypotheses

EventState.description: Event lifecycle state spanning cognition (Hypothesized, Corroborated), effect (AlertDelivered), and authority (Witnessed, Resolved)
EventState.ambiguity_reason: Enum spans states across all three planes: cognition (Hypothesized), effect (AlertDelivered), authority (Resolved)

AlertEffectRecord.description: Boundary record linking cognitive event revision to effect dispatch and provider receipt
AlertEffectRecord.ambiguity_reason: Audited boundary record coupling cognition event revision digest with effect operation ID and terminal state

EventDecodeError.description: Typed error enum for event decoding

EventTransitionError.description: Typed error enum for event state transition violations
